content.title: These Five Stocks Had Their Worst Year in Decades
content.summary: Pressures including U.S. tariffs, AI-related disruption and more pummeled five companies in 2025 to the point that they had their worst annual performance in at least 20 years, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Drinks-maker Constellation Brands’ 37% drop puts it on pace for its worst loss since 1987.  Brown & Brown’s 22% tumble is on track to be the insurer’s toughest year since 1990.
